versos.texto_bv: Ao longo da largura do muro do átrio, do lado sul, diante da área separada e diante do edifício, havia câmaras.
versos.traducao_literal: Na largura do muro do átrio, na direção do leste, diante da área separada e diante do edifício: câmaras.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): O texto_bv diz “do lado sul”, mas a traducao_literal do mesmo verso diz “na direção do leste” — divergência de direção geográfica dentro do próprio registro. — evidência: traducao_literal: “na direção do leste”; ARA concorda com a literal (“que dava para o oriente”); já a NVIPT concorda com o texto_bv (“No lado sul”). Ez 42.10 é crux textual conhecido: o TM traz קָדִים (“leste”), mas o paralelismo estrutural com as câmaras do sul descritas em 42.12 leva parte da tradição de tradução a emendar para “sul” (LXX/contexto). Uniformizar texto_bv e traducao_literal exigiria escolher entre as duas leituras — mudança de sentido, fora do escopo de revisão de forma. Registrado para decisão exegética/textual-crítica do mantenedor antes de promoção.

kjv.texto: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

vizinhos.9: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
vizinhos.11: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

web.texto: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

vizinhos.9: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.
vizinhos.11: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north; according to their length so was their breadth: and all their exits were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
